supporting_observations.claim: The alerted account creation is visible: ext.rwong was created on DC-NWD-01 at 13:44:07 UTC by nora.blake.
The DC authentication record shortly before creation identifies nora.blake connecting from WS-NBLAKE-01; its logon ID matches the subject logon ID on the account-creation event.

nora.blake added ext.rwong to the Freelancers group shortly after creation, using the same subject logon ID as the creation event. This matches the documented help-desk pattern for temporary accounts, but does not by itself establish that no other memberships were added.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied records show the account creation and a Freelancers group addition, but do not establish that all account-management or group-membership events for the alert window were collected. Records T048-00007 and T048-00008 are the relevant supplied DC account-management records.
The supplied evidence does not include a complete group-membership snapshot or subsequent authentication and use history for ext.rwong.
claims_not_established: Whether ext.rwong was requested and approved for a legitimate business purpose or has a corresponding help-desk ticket.
Whether ext.rwong received any additional group memberships or privileges beyond the Freelancers addition shown.
Whether the account was used after creation and, if so, by whom.
additional_evidence_needed: Retrieve complete DC account-management and group-membership audit events for the alert window, including any additions to privileged groups, and verify ext.rwong's current group memberships and account properties.
Check the help-desk request or ticket for ext.rwong, including the requested owner, purpose, and expected expiration.
Review authentication and activity for ext.rwong after creation to determine whether and how the account was used.
unrelated_findings: Cisco AnyConnect vpnui.exe started on WS-NBLAKE-01 and loaded a Cisco-signed DLL. The inventory says there is no VPN, but these records do not establish that a VPN connection occurred; treat this as a separate review and not as evidence deciding the account-creation alert.
